# case styles — `codes/`

## Project layout

    codes/
    └─ [code=A(2..3)0(..2)].txt 0+  a country code

A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

In `[code=A(2..3)0(..2)]`, the text after `=` is a mask: each character matches one character of the name. `0` matches a digit and `A` a capital letter. `(m..n)` repeats the element before it m to n times, `(m..)` at least m times and `(..n)` at most n times. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.
